
'''any-extended-rafsi''' is a [[Morphology: fu'ivla|fu'ivla]], a '''fu'ivla-rafsi''', a  '''stressed-fu'ivla-rafsi''', a '''brivla-rafsi''' or a '''stressed-brivla-rafsi'''.

A '''fu'ivla-rafsi''' consists of one or more [[Morphology: syllables|unstressed-syllable]]s and a [[Morphology: syllables|y-syllable]] and possibly an [[Morphology: consonants]], such that it starts with a non-[[Morphology: consonants]] [[Morphology: syllables|onset]], it doesn't start with a [[Morphology: cmavo|cmavo]], and it is not a y-final '''rafsi-string''' or a '''slinkujy'''.

A '''stressed-fu'ivla-rafsi''' consists of any number of [[Morphology: syllables|unstressed-syllable]]s (possibly none), one [[Morphology: syllables|stressed-syllable]] and then a [[Morphology: syllables|y-syllable]], such that it starts with a non-[[Morphology: consonants]] [[Morphology: syllables|onset]], it doesn't start with a [[Morphology: cmavo|cmavo]], and it is not a y-final '''rafsi-string''' or a '''slinkujy'''.

A '''brivla-rafsi''' consists of two or more [[Morphology: syllables|unstressed-syllable]]s, an [[Morphology: consonants]]), and a [[Morphology: vowels]] and possibly another [[Morphology: consonants]], such that it starts with a non-[[Morphology: consonants]] [[Morphology: syllables|onset]], it doesn't start with a [[Morphology: cmavo|cmavo]], and it is not a '''slinkujy'''.

A '''stressed-brivla-rafsi''' consists of one or more [[Morphology: syllables|unstressed-syllable]]s, one [[Morphology: syllables|stressed-syllable]] an [[Morphology: consonants]]), and a [[Morphology: vowels]], such that it starts with a non-[[Morphology: consonants]] [[Morphology: syllables|onset]], it doesn't start with a [[Morphology: cmavo|cmavo]], and it is not a '''slinkujy'''.

A '''slinkujy''' is a  [[Morphology: consonants|consonant]] followed by a y-final '''rafsi-string'''

A y-final '''rafsi-string''' consists of any number of [[Morphology: rafsi|y-less-rafsi]] (possibly none) followed by a  [[Morphology: rafsi|y-rafsi]], a [[Morphology: rafsi|stressed-y-rafsi]], a [[Morphology: rafsi|stressed-y-less-rafsi]] plus an [[Morphology: consonants|initial-pair]] and a [[Morphology: vowels]], or just an [[Morphology: consonants|initial-pair]] and a [[Morphology: vowels]].
